items.t: FAA Chief Warns System ‘Will Continue to Break.’ AT&T, Verizon, and Lumen Could Be Big Winners
items.sum: When the nation's top aviation regulator admits the air traffic system is guaranteed to fail again, someone gets paid to fix it. One telecom giant already holds a foothold in the contract, and its stock may be pricing in far too little.
